data.title: Route Overview
paragraphs: This is a journey through built space. Madurai begins with temple urbanism and markets, Chettinad slows the pace inside vast merchant houses and tile-lined courtyards, and the Chola country shifts attention toward monumental temples, bronze traditions, music, and river-fed agriculture.

Food is treated as architecture’s companion: market breakfasts, Chettinad kitchens, temple-town tiffin, and home-style meals create a second route through the region. Several two-night stays protect the experience from becoming a temple checklist.

Kumbakonam-area craft villages, bronze work, weaving, and temple landscapes.

introParagraphs: This 10-day journey is paced around meaningful stays, sensible road movement, and enough time in each landscape to understand it rather than simply pass through.

data.title: Journey Standards & Inclusions
items: Heritage mansions and intimate hotels with strong architectural identity.
Private vehicle with city walks scheduled early to avoid heat and crowds.
Architecture, craft, and food specialists used selectively rather than one generic guide throughout.
Temple visits balanced with homes, workshops, markets, and time inside living neighbourhoods.

data.title: Suggested Packing & Preparation
items: Modest, breathable clothing for temples and warm afternoons.
Easy footwear that can be removed frequently at sacred sites.
A light shawl for early mornings and air-conditioned interiors.
Sun protection for palace courtyards and exposed temple complexes.
Extra luggage space if you plan to purchase textiles, tiles, or craft objects.

data.title: TEMPLE & HEAT NOTE
data.text: Major temple visits are planned for early morning or late afternoon whenever possible. Midday is better used for craft studios, lunches, rest, and shaded heritage interiors.

data.title: The House, the Temple, the Street
paragraphs: Chettinad and Chola country become more meaningful when experienced as living systems rather than isolated monuments. Houses, streets, kitchens, workshops, and temples all participate in the same cultural landscape.
The journey ends with an eye trained for detail: a bronze surface, a kolam at a threshold, the depth of a courtyard, and the geometry of a gopuram against evening light.

items.question: Can this route be tailored to our preferred dates and pace?
paragraphs: Yes. Every Signature itinerary is a design framework, and we adjust nights, experiences, transport, and daily intensity around your interests and travel dates.

items.question: Is the itinerary heavily temple-focused?
paragraphs: Temples are important, but roughly half the experience is architecture, food, craft, markets, and heritage homes.

items.question: Can the route include a cooking-focused day?
paragraphs: Yes. Chettinad is particularly suitable for a deeper private culinary programme.

items.question: Are heritage mansions comfortable for luxury travellers?
paragraphs: We select restored properties carefully, balancing architectural character with modern comfort and service.

items.question: What is included when the final journey is quoted?
paragraphs: The final proposal clearly separates accommodation, private transport, guiding, arranged experiences, and any route-specific permits or specialist access.
items.listTitle: The exact inclusion list is confirmed before payment:
listItems: Chosen accommodation category and meal plan.
Confirmed guiding, hosted encounters, and ticketed experiences.
Any permits or special-access costs included in the final design.

items.question: How are reservations confirmed and scheduled?
paragraphs: Once the bespoke route, accommodation selection, and current supplier availability are approved, a 30% confirmation deposit secures the agreed services. The remaining balance is due 45 days before arrival unless the final proposal states otherwise.

items.question: What is the policy for date changes or cancellations?
paragraphs: We work directly with our partners to move dates whenever possible. Any non-refundable permits, transport tickets, or supplier penalties are passed through transparently.
listItems: 60+ days before arrival: deposit refund less confirmed non-refundable costs.
30–59 days before arrival: 50% refund or travel credit where supplier terms allow.
Less than 30 days before arrival: cancellation follows the confirmed supplier terms in your final proposal.
